en: Black‑and‑white panoramic view over a town in a wide valley with fields and scattered houses stretching towards distant low mountains. In the foreground are dense clusters of multi‑storey historic buildings and villas surrounded by trees; further back are railway lines, farms, and small settlements. The caption in German at the bottom margin identifies the view as looking from Freundschaftshöhe toward the town and the Ore Mountains (Erzgebirge). The overall layout and print style resemble a mid‑20th‑century tourist postcard.
